propositions: rebar metrics command and registry exist but are not consulted by rebar-janitor Discovery phase or documented in project guides, making them effectively undiscoverable

rebar-janitor Discovery phase currently uses one-shot tools (cloc/tokei/ast-grep/git log) for size/growth/decay but lacks the trend dimension that rebar metrics provides via registered code-health-lens metrics (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, module-size trend vs 800-line cap, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events)

rebar metrics command output includes four metric lenses (agent_process, code_health, delivery, gate_economics), source/confidence labels, and unavailable state (reason + accruing_since), but this surface and its semantics are not documented in user-guide or referenced in reuse-surface
discovery.md and AGENTS.md currently lack guidance or pointers to the metrics subsystem, blocking agents and contributors from finding or citing metrics as historical code-health evidence
